findings.summary: Spec §5 (lines 121-122) explicitly requires the dev-note's input_commit to equal the final delivery commit and warns the gate checks this item. docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g4a_question_wiring_01.md:5 records input_commit `d375b8fa2501fa82098ea2a46c830dd5bf0325eb`, but the continuous_review subject_commit / final delivery is `3917a16726c86cc4d27bbee37767a2b9dce610e1`. The final commit appears in zero tracked evidence files (grep of `3917a167...` returned no matches), while `d375b8fa...` matches both the dev-note and the implement handoff's input_commit (work_head_commit `319ba9d3...`). This is exactly the 'note stayed at an earlier commit, numbers don't match deliverables' anti-pattern the spec was hardened against after the D1 incident. The functional wiring (bin→fleet→workflow→tick.md argv for --question, no built-in default, Q1-Q4 tests) is correct and complete against §1/§2, but Q8 evidence integrity fails because the deliverable dev-note is stale relative to the subject commit.
